say: Who is prime Mo Salah's statistical twin? Last five seasons, every Premier League attacker.
cap: WHO IS PRIME MO SALAH'S STATISTICAL TWIN? LAST FIVE SEASONS, EVERY PREMIER LEAGUE ATTACKER.

cap: FIRST, SALAH HIMSELF. THREE OF HIS OWN SEASONS MADE THE TOP EIGHT. THEY DON'T COUNT. SO THAT LEAVES FIVE.

say: Number five: Son Heung-min. Tottenham. Seventy-six percent.
Four: Harvey Barnes. Newcastle. Seventy-six percent.
You'd think Saka would be up here? He's twenty-eighth.

say: And number one... Cole Palmer. His first season at Chelsea. Seventy-nine percent. That makes him Salah's statistical twin.

cap: WE CHANGED HOW MUCH EACH STAT COUNTS, 2,000|two-thousand TIMES. PALMER CAME FIRST IN 79%|x-percent OF THEM.

cap: WHY? THEY CREATE THE SAME. NEARLY TWO AND A HALF CHANCES EVERY 90|ninety MINUTES. THE SAME SHOTS ON TARGET.

say: The difference? Palmer passes way more. Salah scores more, and makes more big chances.
cap: THE DIFFERENCE? PALMER PASSES WAY MORE. SALAH SCORES MORE, AND MAKES MORE BIG CHANCES.
